tools.name: workos_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations in the WorkOS environment, with optional search. WorkOS API: GET /organizations.

tools.name: workos_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization by its WorkOS id. WorkOS API: GET /organizations/{id}.

tools.name: workos_get_organization_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one organization by the external id your application set on it. WorkOS API: GET /organizations/external_id/{external_id}.

tools.name: workos_list_organization_groups
tools.description: List the groups of one organization, with optional search. WorkOS API: GET /organizations/{organizationId}/groups.

tools.name: workos_list_connections
tools.description: List SSO connections (SAML, OIDC, Google Workspace, Microsoft, and others), filtered by organization, type, domain or state. WorkOS API: GET /connections.

tools.name: workos_get_connection
tools.description: Get one SSO connection by its id. WorkOS API: GET /connections/{id}.

tools.name: workos_list_directories
tools.description: List Directory Sync directories (SCIM, Okta, Google, and others), filtered by organization, domain or search. WorkOS API: GET /directories.

tools.name: workos_get_directory
tools.description: Get one Directory Sync directory by its id, including its sync status. WorkOS API: GET /directories/{id}.

tools.name: workos_list_directory_users
tools.description: List users synced from directories, filtered by directory, group, email or the identity provider id. WorkOS API: GET /directory_users.

tools.name: workos_get_directory_user
tools.description: Get one directory user by its id, with the attributes and groups synced from the directory. WorkOS API: GET /directory_users/{id}.

tools.name: workos_list_directory_groups
tools.description: List groups synced from directories, filtered by directory or by a member user id. WorkOS API: GET /directory_groups.

tools.name: workos_list_users
tools.description: List User Management users (AuthKit), filtered by email or organization. WorkOS API: GET /user_management/users.

tools.name: workos_get_user
tools.description: Get one User Management user by its id (user_…). WorkOS API: GET /user_management/users/{id}.

tools.name: workos_list_organization_memberships
tools.description: List which users belong to which organizations, filtered by organization, user or status (active, inactive, pending). WorkOS API: GET /user_management/organization_memberships.

tools.name: workos_list_invitations
tools.description: List pending and past user invitations, filtered by organization or email. WorkOS API: GET /user_management/invitations.

tools.name: workos_list_events
tools.description: List WorkOS events (for example dsync.user.created or connection.activated) in a time range. The events list is required. WorkOS API: GET /events.

tools.name: workos_list_feature_flags
tools.description: List the feature flags defined in the WorkOS environment. WorkOS API: GET /feature-flags.

tools.name: workos_list_roles
tools.description: List the fine-grained authorization roles defined in the WorkOS environment. WorkOS API: GET /authorization/roles.

tools.name: workos_list_permissions
tools.description: List the fine-grained authorization permissions defined in the WorkOS environment. WorkOS API: GET /authorization/permissions.

tools.name: workos_sync_directory
tools.description: Start a Directory Sync for one directory, so WorkOS pulls the latest users and groups from the identity provider. Repeating it is safe. WorkOS API: POST /directories/{id}/sync.

tools.name: workos_revoke_invitation
tools.description: Revoke a pending user invitation, so the invite link stops working. This cannot be undone: a new invitation is needed. WorkOS API: POST /user_management/invitations/{id}/revoke.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workos_list_directory_users, workos_list_users, workos_list_invitations · Public sink: workos_list_directory_users, workos_list_users, workos_list_invitations, workos_sync_directory, workos_revoke_invitation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workos_list_directory_users, workos_list_users, workos_list_invitations · Public sink: workos_list_directory_users, workos_list_users, workos_list_invitations, workos_sync_directory, workos_revoke_invitation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
